title: Moral Susceptibility and Robustness under Persona Role-Play in Large Language Models
findings: The study's findings related to religion are indirect, focusing on the 'Purity/Sanctity' moral foundation, which often has religious connotations. The paper found that the correlation between moral robustness and susceptibility for the Purity/Sanctity foundation was negative, unlike other foundations which showed a positive correlation. The Grok model family was identified as an outlier, displaying particularly low robustness and high susceptibility within the Purity/Sanctity foundation.

measurement_description: The benchmark measures moral susceptibility and robustness in LLMs using the Moral Foundations Questionnaire (MFQ). This includes the 'Purity/Sanctity' foundation, which assesses intuitions about divinity, sacredness, and spiritual purity, often related to religious beliefs.
